'''Numidian Prime''' was a [[jungle]] [[planet]] on the edge of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]], known for being a haven for [[smuggler]]s and [[Thief|thieves]], such as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Shenda Mol]], who operated a [[Mol's hideout|stronghold]] on the planet. During the [[Imperial Era]], the future [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] won the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' from the [[gambler]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] on Numidian Prime.

==Description==
Located on the edge of<ref name="Databank" /> [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]],<ref name="Official Guide" /> in grid square L-7 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Coordinates" /> Numidian Prime was a [[Temperature|warm]] and beautiful [[jungle]] [[planet]],<ref name="Databank" /> though it also had [[swamp]] terrain.<ref name="Master & Apprentice" /> The terrestrial planet had a breathable [[atmosphere]]<ref name="Solo" /> and was a comfortable environment for human habitation, which made it an exotic resort destination.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Apart from the dense plant life it also was inhabited by a [[species]] of [[bird]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==History==
During the [[High Republic Era]], [[Axel Greylark]] spent two days in a jungle on Numidian Prime before his mother, [[Kyong Greylark]], transmitted a ransom for him.<ref name="Convergence">''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]''</ref>

During the [[Republic Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], the [[bounty hunter]] [[Shenda Mol]] had a [[Mol's hideout|stronghold]] and several followers on Numidian Prime. The [[Jedi]] [[Dooku]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], as part of a [[Numidian Prime strike team|strike team]], tracked her to the stronghold, apprehending both Mol and her followers and [[Prison|imprisoning]] her on the planet [[Stygeon Prime]].<ref name="Master & Apprentice" />

[[File:SWSolo-NumidianPrime.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' leaving Numidian Prime]]
The card game [[sabacc]] had a set of rules based on Numidian Prime, and the [[gambler]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] once held a winning hand according to them.<ref name="Official Guide" /> Calrissian also won a disabler device playing a game of cards on Numidian Prime.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>

Following a [[Raid on Kessel|mission]] undertaken by the [[Beckett's gang|crew]] of [[Tobias Beckett]] for the [[Crimson Dawn]] crime syndicate, in which Calrissian had been hired for the use of his [[starship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', the gambler [[Showdown on Savareen|abandoned]] Beckett's gang on [[Savareen]], visiting Numidian Prime. Two former members of Beckett's crew, [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]],<ref name="Solo" /> eventually made their way to the planet,<ref name="Solo Adaptation 7">[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 7|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 7]]</ref> where Solo won the ''Millennium Falcon'' from Calrissian in a game of sabacc.<ref name="Solo" />

Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''Doctor Aphra'' 31 take place after the [[Escape from Cloud City]] and before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> the Jedi [[Luke Skywalker]] traveled to Numidian Prime along with the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] in search of a [[Unidentified temple (Numidian Prime)|temple]] there. After being unable to find it, Skywalker encountered [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra|Chelli Aphra]],<ref name="Aphra 31">[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 31|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 31]]</ref> who captured Skywalker as a means to recruit the Jedi for a mission.<ref name="Aphra 32">[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 32|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 32]]</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Criminals who were trying to avoid outstanding debts were known to hide on Numidian Prime.<ref name="Databank" /> The [[Falleen]] bounty hunter Shenda Mol resided on the planet, and had a number of followers there.<ref name="Master & Apprentice" />

==Locations==
A well-hidden and secure [[jungle outpost]] was located on the planet,<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> along with the stronghold of Shenda Mol, which was situated in a stony valley within Numidian Prime's jungles.<ref name="Master & Apprentice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Numidian Prime first appeared in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', a [[2018]] theatrical film part of the ''[[Star Wars Anthology Series]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The name "Numidian Prime" appeared for the first time in the reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]],<ref name="Official Guide" /> but it was not connected to the planet seen in ''Solo'' until the release of the novelization, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'', written by [[Mur Lafferty]],<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> along with the [[Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]], written by [[Joe Schreiber]],<ref name="Junior novel">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> and the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Databank" />
